name: ZFP 16 Input output PCB (full size) – open collector outputs (15 cards mixed type can be connected on ABUS on the ZFP panel)
family: Analogue Addressable ZFP Networkable Fire Panels
summary: The Context Plus Z14 is a 16-Way Input Output PCB designed to enhance the functionality of a ZFP addressable fire panel.
description: Provides 16 monitored swich inputs/open collector outputs (dependent on wiring configuration used).
Full size PCB can be scored in the middle to produce a half size 8 Input Output PCB.
Programmable via the ZFP’s PC Tools.
Polling, power and separate Input/Output Activated LED indicators.
Up to 15 A-BUS Expansion PCBs can be connected to a ZFP Panel via its RS485 A-BUS network.
Typically installed within the ZFP panel but can work up to 1 KM away for non-EN 54-2 functions.

Connections:  A-BUS RS485 connections (B, A, 0) to main ZFP PCB; 24V supply input (from main ZFP PCB or external EN54-4 PSU); Comms and Power In/Out connections. 16 monitored switch inputs/open collector outputs (dependent on wiring configuration used).

specs.label: Type
specs.value: 16 monitored swich inputs/open collector outputs (dependent on wiring configuration used).

specs.label: Indicators
specs.value: Polling LED; Power LED; Input/Output Activated (x16).

specs.label: Product dimensions
specs.value: (mm) 80 W x 150 H x 30 D mm.

specs.label: Network specification
specs.value: Dedicated A-BUS RS485 monitored radial circuit. 1KM max length. Up to 15 A-BUS PCBs per panel.

specs.label: Notes
specs.value: Inputs active when switched to GND (28mA current per active input); 100mA open collector output sink; Use Dipswitch SW1 to set the PCB's address – see main ZFP panel instructions for details.
